p.i: A revelation given at Jackson County, Missouri, 1 August 1831, through Joseph Smith Jr. to Edward Partridge, Martin Harris, William W. Phelps, Sidney Rigdon, Joseph Smith Jr., Oliver Cowdery, Ziba Peterson, and other elders of the church.

chapter.li: LEChapter58 Verse1 Hearken, O you elders of my church, and give ear to my word, and learn of me what I will concerning you, and also concerning this land unto which I have sent you. VerseEnd Verse2 For truly I say unto you, blessed is he that keeps my commandments, whether in life or in death, and he that is faithful in tribulation, the reward of the same is greater in the Kingdom of Heaven. VerseEnd Verse3 You cannot behold with your natural eyes, for the present time, the design of your God concerning those things which shall come hereafter and the glory which shall follow after much tribulation, VerseEnd Verse4 for after much tribulation comes the blessings. Wherefore, the day comes that you shall be crowned with much glory. The hour is not yet, but is nearly at hand. VerseEnd

Verse5 Remember this, which I tell you before that you may lay it to heart, and receive that which shall follow. VerseEnd Verse6 Behold, truly I say unto you, for this cause I have sent you — that you might be obedient, and that your hearts might be prepared to bear testimony of the things which are to come, VerseEnd Verse7 and also that you might be honored of laying the foundation and of bearing record of the land upon which the Zion of God shall stand. VerseEnd Verse8 And also, that a feast of fat things might be prepared for the poor, yea, a feast of fat things, of wine on the lees well refined, that the earth may know that the mouths of the prophets shall not fail; VerseEnd Verse9 yea, a supper of the House of the Lord, well prepared, unto which all nations shall be invited: VerseEnd Verse10 firstly, the rich and the learned, the wise and the noble, VerseEnd Verse11 and after that comes the day of my power. Then shall the poor, the lame, and the blind, and the deaf come in unto the marriage of the Lamb, and partake of the supper of the Lord prepared for the great day to come. VerseEnd Verse12 Behold, I, the Lord, have spoken it. VerseEnd

Verse13 And that the testimony might go forth from Zion, yea, from the mouth of the city of the heritage of God, VerseEnd Verse14 yea, for this cause I have sent you hither and I have selected my servant Edward, and appointed unto him his mission in this land. VerseEnd Verse15 But if he repent not of his sins, which are unbelief and blindness of heart, let him take heed so that he doesn't VerseEnd Verse16 fall. Behold, his mission is given unto him, and it shall not be given again. VerseEnd Verse17 And whoever stands in this mission is appointed to be a judge in Israel, like as it was in ancient days, to divide the lands of the heritage of God unto his children, VerseEnd Verse18 and to judge his people by the testimony of the just, and by the assistance of his counselors, according to the laws of the Kingdom which are given by the prophets of God. VerseEnd

Verse19 For truly I say unto you, my laws shall be kept on this land. VerseEnd Verse20 Let no man think that he is ruler, but let God rule him that judges according to the counsel of his own will, or in other words, he that counsels or sits upon the judgment seat. VerseEnd Verse21 Let no man break the laws of the land, for he that keeps the laws of God has no need to break the laws of the land. VerseEnd

Verse22 Wherefore, be subject to the powers that be until he reigns whose right it is to reign, and subdues all enemies under his feet. VerseEnd Verse23 Behold, the laws which you have received from my hand are the laws of the church, and in this light you shall hold them forth. Behold, here is wisdom. VerseEnd

Verse24 And now as I spoke concerning my servant Edward Partridge, this land is the land of his residence, and those whom he has appointed for his counselors, and also the land of the residence of him whom I have appointed to keep my storehouse. VerseEnd Verse25 Wherefore, let them bring their families to this land, as they shall counsel between themselves and me. VerseEnd Verse26 For behold, it is not meet that I should command in all things, for he that is compelled in all things, the same is a slothful and not a wise servant, wherefore, he receives no reward. VerseEnd Verse27 Truly I say, men should be anxiously engaged in a good cause, and do many things of their own free will, and bring to pass much righteousness, VerseEnd Verse28 for the power is in them wherein they are agents unto themselves. And inasmuch as men do good, they shall in no way lose their reward, VerseEnd Verse29 but he that does not anything until he is commanded, and receives a commandment with a doubtful heart, and keeps it with slothfulness, the same is damned. VerseEnd

Verse30 Who am I that made man, says the Lord, that will hold him guiltless that obey not my commandments? VerseEnd Verse31 Who am I, says the Lord, that have promised and have not fulfilled? VerseEnd Verse32 I command and men obey not, I revoke and they receive not the blessing, VerseEnd Verse33 then they say in their hearts, This is not the work of the Lord, for his promises are not fulfilled. But woe unto such, for their reward lurks beneath, and not from above. VerseEnd

Verse34 And now I give unto you further directions concerning this land. VerseEnd Verse35 It is wisdom in me that my servant Martin should be an example unto the church, in laying his moneys before the bishop of the church. VerseEnd Verse36 And also, this is a law unto every man that comes unto this land to receive an inheritance, and he shall do with his moneys according as the law directs. VerseEnd Verse37 And it is wisdom also that there should be lands purchased in Independence for the place of the storehouse, and also for the house of the printing. VerseEnd Verse38 And other directions concerning my servant Martin Harris shall be given him of the spirit, that he may receive his inheritance as seems best to him. VerseEnd Verse39 And let him repent of his sins, for he seeks the praise of the world. VerseEnd

Verse40 And also, let my servant William W. Phelps stand in the office which I have appointed him and receive his inheritance in the land. VerseEnd Verse41 And also, he has need to repent, for I, the Lord, am not pleased with him, for he seeks to excel, and he is not sufficiently meek before me. VerseEnd Verse42 Behold, he that has repented of his sins, the same is forgiven, and I, the Lord, remember them no more. VerseEnd Verse43 By this you may know if a man repents of his sins: behold, he will confess them and forsake them. VerseEnd

Verse44 And now truly I say concerning the residue of the elders of my church, the time has not yet come, for many years, for them to receive their inheritance in this land, except they desire it through the prayer of faith, only as it shall be appointed unto them of the Lord. VerseEnd Verse45 For behold, they shall push the people together from the ends of the earth. VerseEnd Verse46 Wherefore, assemble yourselves together, and they who are not appointed to stay in this land, let them preach the gospel in the regions round about; and after that, let them return to their homes. VerseEnd Verse47 Let them preach by the way, and bear testimony of the truth in all places, and call upon the rich, the high, and the low, and the poor, to repent. VerseEnd Verse48 And let them build up churches, inasmuch as the inhabitants of the earth will repent. VerseEnd

Verse49 And let there be an agent appointed by the voice of the church, unto the church in Ohio, to receive moneys to purchase lands in Zion. VerseEnd Verse50 And I give unto my servant Sidney Rigdon a commandment that he shall write a description of the land of Zion and a statement of the will of God, as it shall be made known by the spirit unto him, VerseEnd Verse51 and an epistle and subscription, to be presented unto all the churches to obtain moneys to be put into the hands of the bishop to purchase lands for an inheritance for the children of God, of himself or the agent, as seems best to him, or as he shall direct. VerseEnd Verse52 For behold, truly I say unto you, the Lord wills that the disciples and the children of men should open their hearts, even to purchase this whole region of country as soon as time will permit. VerseEnd
Verse53 Behold, here is wisdom: Let them do this for fear they don't reserve an inheritance except by the shedding of blood. VerseEnd

Verse54 And again, inasmuch as there be lands obtained, let there be workmen sent forth of all kinds unto this land to labor for the saints of God. VerseEnd Verse55 Let all these things be done in order, and let the privileges of the lands be made known from time to time by the bishop or the agent of the church. VerseEnd Verse56 And let the work of the gathering be not in haste, nor by flight, but let it be done as it shall be counseled by the elders of the church at the conferences, according to the knowledge which they receive from time to time. VerseEnd Verse57 And let my servant Sidney Rigdon consecrate and dedicate this land and the spot of the temple unto the Lord. VerseEnd

Verse58 And let a conference meeting be called, and after that let my servants Sidney Rigdon and Joseph Smith Jr. return, and also Oliver Cowdery with them, to accomplish the residue of the work which I have appointed unto them in their own land, and the residue as shall be ruled by the conference. VerseEnd Verse59 And let no man return from this land except he bear record by the way of that which he knows and most assuredly believes. VerseEnd

Verse60 Let that which has been bestowed upon Ziba Peterson be taken from him, and let him stand as a member in the church and labor with his own hands, with the brethren, until he is sufficiently chastened for all his sins, for he confesses them not and he thinks to hide them. VerseEnd

Verse61 Let the residue of the elders of this church who are coming to this land, some of whom are exceedingly blessed, even above measure, also hold a conference upon this land, VerseEnd Verse62 and let my servant Edward direct the conference which shall be held by them. VerseEnd Verse63 And let them also return, preaching the gospel by the way, bearing record of the things which are revealed unto them. VerseEnd Verse64 For truly, the sound must go forth from this place into all the world, and unto the uttermost parts of the earth. The gospel must be preached unto every creature, with signs following them that believe. VerseEnd Verse65 And behold, the Son of Man comes. Amen. VerseEnd
